headline: NETANYAHU'S BLOC LOSES PARLIAMENTARY MAJORITY
facebook_description:
🚨 NETANYAHU'S BLOC LOSES PARLIAMENTARY MAJORITY

Israel's completed election count leaves Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's allies with 53 of 120 Knesset seats—eight short of a majority. The main opposition bloc won 48 seats, while Arab-led parties secured 19.

Likud remains the largest single party, but Netanyahu cannot form a majority government with his current bloc alone. He remains prime minister as coalition negotiations begin. The results are due to be formally submitted to President Isaac Herzog on November 4.

Can Israel's divided parties agree on a government—or will another election follow?
